'''Noriko Shitaya''' (Japanese: '''下屋則子''' ''Shitaya Noriko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Shitaya was born on April 22, 1982 in the {{wp|Chiba Prefecture}} of {{wp|Chiba City}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, she became a voice actress and is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}. She became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}. Two of her major roles were [[Santalune City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Viola]], and [[Serena's Pancham]].
